text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, understood.
We'll cover the rest in tomorrow's meeting, then...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah, excuse me. It looks like it's almost time for class roll call.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's leave the rest for when we get back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Please excuse me for a moment, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp, where we shared
so many events and experiences together, came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training camp was meant to be a period of
making great leaps in preparation for the fall, but—
choice_data_list: (I can feel it... it's definitely working!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Trainer <username>,

Thank you for your hard work. Here is my daily report for today."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.7°C (normal), no body pain.
Meals: Attached records for 3 meals + 3 snacks."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I was reviewing all the data updated during summer training camp, I received the usual daily report from Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Remarks:
This was a very meaningful summer training camp.
I look forward to continuing to work with you tomorrow and beyond."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I run my eyes up and down the page several times,
carefully reading through the contents.
A serious report, straightforward writing... just like always.
choice_data_list: It's the usual Messiah... at his absolute strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was writing a reply, the night breeze crept
in through the open window. It was a chilly wind
that had already lost all traces of autumn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shivered, but not from the cold.
...It was the thrill of the hunt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“And I will definitely win.”
As if making a vow, I looked up at the moon.
